main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-day move in the short direction per short-bet case

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: t <= -2

supporting_check.name: share given back, top minus bottom half of |forecast|, Welch t

decided_by: Inconclusive: enough cases, but the numbers meet neither the confirm rule (both t >= 2) nor the reject rule (either t <= -2).
reading: A case is the first short bet (|forecast| rising >= 2 from its lowest size since the last bet, reset at flat or side change) in each 5-bar grid cell of a window, the share given back is the short-direction unusual move over the 3-day price rise to that bar, and the halves are split by sorting cases on |forecast| (ties by time) with the lower floor(n/2) as the bottom half.
